title: Jadeveon Clowney: Signing with the Texans was "a really easy decision"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jadeveon Clowney: Signing with the Texans was "a really easy decision"
sources.description: “I've grown up and learned the game a lot more since leaving,” Clowney said. “I feel like I can help the younger guys."
